dedupe_keys.name: nachweis uber in der bgr vorhandene erdgas daten fur deutschland

description: Nachweis über in der BGR vorhandene Erdgas-Daten für Deutschland is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The point map depicts hydrocarbon wells in the Federal Republic of Germany for which gas geochemical data (gas composition and stable carbon and hydrogen isotopic composition of gaseous hydrocarbons) are available at the Federal Institute for Geosciences and Natural Resources (BGR). Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Existing natural gas data in the BGR for Germany" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include natural gas, Energierohstoffe, Energy Resources, Erdgas, Deutschland, Geology. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
